title: Washington Small Claims Court (2026): Limit, Fees & How to File
rank_math_title: Washington Small Claims Court (2026): $10,000 Limit & Fee
rank_math_description: Washington small claims in 2026: $10,000 for individuals, $5,000 for businesses, $35 fee, lawyers only with consent, 10-day service rule and appeal limits.
pdf_outline: Checklist: demand letter -> district court -> Notice of Small Claim (verified) -> $35 + surcharge -> service complete 10 days before hearing -> mediation option -> hearing -> appeal thresholds ($250 / $1,000) -> 30 days to pay, then garnishment / superior court lien docket
